header: Figures describing the people around a product
lead: Two to six numbers, each with its label and an optional line of context. Every figure is set at one optical size with lining digits, so a five-figure count never dwarfs a two-figure one beside it.

stats.title: Figures in the set
stats.text: One figure alone belongs in the used-by counter.

stats.title: Figures in the set
stats.text: Past six the set stops being balanced and becomes a table.

stats.title: Stored as text
stats.text: So an editor can write 12k or 12,400 and keep the register the page needs.

stats.title: Customers described
stats.text: These numbers are your own reach; one customer's project is the metrics band.
